authority_recovery.canonical_objective: UQ-T7 asks whether changing rules, continuous dynamics, embodied coupling, incompatible ontologies, and nonclassical consequence can be represented without material expressive loss.
authority_recovery.user_discrepancy: The requested case list is broader than UQ-T7, adding semantic change, probability, causal/counterfactual structure, oracle access, merge/quotient, deletion/relaxation, and provenance-sensitive history; these are executed as registered extensions without changing UQ-T7.
authority_recovery.faithfulness_boundary: No canonical general representation contract exists for UQ-T7; this execution freezes an auxiliary contract and does not amend canonical FARA semantics.

contract.source_system: A declared reasoning system S=(X,R,Sem,Step,Obs,Hist,Ext) with explicit identity criteria and a declared observation interface.
contract.target_representation: finite_tagged_archive_v1: a finite JSON tree of typed, identity-bearing source records; it is data, not an interpreter, oracle, physical coupling, or proof assistant.
contract.encoding_map: E serializes every declared finite explicit component injectively using type tags, stable identifiers, ordered histories, rational numbers as reduced integer pairs, and total transition tables.
contract.recovery_map: D parses the archive and reconstructs the declared source tuple; malformed, omitted, ambiguous, or unsupported records return a registered failure/unknown value rather than a guessed source.
contract.equivalence: Commitment equivalence is equality of recovered declared source components up to an explicitly declared identifier renaming; observational equivalence is equality of all traces at the full declared Obs interface.
contract.dimension_rule: Each dimension is Pass, Partial, Fail, or Unknown. Unknown never counts as Pass. Lossless requires six Pass values, exact recovery, no hidden auxiliary structure, and the full rather than narrowed observation interface.
contract.uncertainty_output: Unknown with an exact unresolved obligation; never a successful encoding.
scope: finite explicit rule and semantic versions
excluded: uncountable exact state without a finite presentation
tacit or embodied content without an explicit identity criterion
live external facts absent from the archive
unbounded histories represented only by samples

claim_separation.lossless_representability: Representability plus all preservation dimensions Pass and no hidden machinery.
claim_separation.behavioral_equivalence: Full-interface trace observations agree; this can hold without semantic identity.
claim_separation.semantic_equivalence: Declared interpretations and commitments agree; trace agreement alone does not prove it.
claim_separation.historical_dependency_preservation: Ordered provenance and dependency edges agree; final-state equality does not prove it.
claim_separation.operational_simulation: A target process reproduces selected outputs; it is not recovery or losslessness.
claim_separation.bidirectional_translation: Admissible translations in both directions preserve the registered contract; one-way encoding does not prove it.

strongest_results.bounded_sufficient_condition: For any source in the finite explicit contract scope, E is injective up to declared identifier renaming, D(E(S)) is commitment-equivalent to S, and total-table replay preserves full-interface finite traces; therefore the source is losslessly representable under this auxiliary contract.
strongest_results.necessary_condition: Exact recovery by a deterministic D requires E to be injective modulo commitment equivalence: if inequivalent S1 and S2 have E(S1)=E(S2), D cannot recover both. Full behavioral equivalence additionally requires preservation of every distinction exposed by the declared observation interface.
failure_results: classical explosion does not preserve paraconsistent consequence
observational distributions do not recover causal interventions
finite prefixes do not recover arbitrary exact reals
live oracle behavior is not contained in query syntax
quotients and final-state projections destroy identity/provenance
unresolved: complete explicit identity criteria for embodied or tacit reasoning
general infinite, continuous, open-world, or oracle-dependent representation

assurance.executable_corroboration: deterministic validator plus exhaustive finite collision checks over the registered bounded fixture universe
assurance.distinction: Executable corroboration checks finite instances and artifact invariants; it is not Lean or other kernel-checked verification.
